verdict.rationale: Graphite describes its AI reviewer as a "codebase-aware AI code review agent" that reviews every PR. Its review-page Chat can "find related files, understand dependencies," which suggests repository-level context beyond the diff, but the docs do not show how review comments use call sites or existing conventions. Custom rules let teams state conventions explicitly, which is not the same as inferring them from the repo. missing for 10: documented detail that review comments analyze call sites and related modules beyond changed hunks, evidence of convention inference from the existing codebase, independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-repo-aware review quality.
